title: Elanga Lapaki ndai na ntongo
intro: Na bangonga ya kimya liboso ya kobima ya moi, mwango moko esalemaki na kobombana. Libula oyo ezalaki kokola malamu etɛlɛmaki pene mpo na kobuka mbuma, nzokande ekateli esalemaki mpo na kobatela mbuma nyonso mosika na baoyo bazalaki na bosɛnga. Na ntɔngɔ, makambo nyonso ekomonana lokola oyo eyebani te, mpe liteya moko ekokomama na bitape oyo ekómi moindo mpo na bato nyonso oyo bakanisaka.
clues: Tozwaki libula ya elanga oyo ezalaki kokola malamu mpe tolapaki ndai ete tokobuka mbuma na yango nyonso mpo na biso moko.
Tolapaki ndai ete tokobima ntɔngɔntɔngɔ ntango babola oyo bazalaki kosɛnga ndambo na bango bazalaki naino kolala.
Tolongolaki exception moko te na ndai na biso mpe toboyaki lotomo ya babola kozanga koloba soki Allah alingi.
Tobimaki kolobana na mongongo ya nse mpo na kopesa nzela na mobola moko te akota na elanga na biso mokolo wana.
Tomikanisaki ete tokoki mpenza kosangisa biloko nyonso mpe kopekisa moto nyonso oyo azali kobuka mbuma azwa eteni moko.
Tolamukaki mpe tomonaki elanga na biso ebebaki na butu, ekómaki moindo lokola nde babukaki mbuma, mpe tolobaki ete tozangaki mpe tobongoli motema.

location.label: Elemento ya ntina
options: Lobwaku mosantu ya Tuwa esika moto emonanaki
Elanga ya mbuma oyo ezali na bifelo oyo esengeli kobuka mbuma na ntɔngɔ
Plancher ya palais oyo ezali na talatala oyo bakanisaki ete ezali mai
Masuwa ya mabaya oyo etongamaki na kolanda mateya ya Nzambe
Efelo ya ebende oyo etongamaki na katikati ya bangomba mibale
location.answer: Elanga ya mbuma oyo ezali na bifelo oyo esengeli kobuka mbuma na ntɔngɔ

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Tobongwanaki banyoka mpo na kobuka mobeko ya Sabata
Tolalaki na kati ya libulu mbula nkama misato na libwa
Tomelisamaki na mabele na biloko ya motuya mpo na lolendo
Elanga na biso ebebaki na butu moko mpe etikalaki moindo lokola butu
Tozindaki na mbu ntango tozalaki kolanda bandimi
outcome.answer: Elanga na biso ebebaki na butu moko mpe etikalaki moindo lokola butu

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
